base_prompt: I want to keep a small balcony pleasant, but I dislike spending weekends on maintenance. Suggest priorities for arranging the space. Please answer in roughly 160 words.
text: Prioritize comfort, clear floor space, and materials that tolerate weather without much attention. Start with one compact chair and a small folding table rather than a full furniture set; choose powder-coated aluminum or durable outdoor plastic that wipes clean easily. Keep the door swing and walking route unobstructed, and check building rules before attaching anything to railings or walls. Add shade only if needed, using a securely fitted option suited to local wind conditions. For greenery, choose two or three generous containers instead of many tiny pots, which dry out quickly and create clutter. Match hardy plants to your balcony’s sunlight and climate, and consider self-watering planters with suitable drainage to reduce watering chores. Skip outdoor rugs and numerous cushions if rain or dust would mean frequent cleaning; one washable seat pad may be enough. Finish with a warm, outdoor-rated light and a small weatherproof storage box. Leave enough open space to sweep easily, making a quick weekly tidy sufficient most weeks.
